newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures weakened in after-hours trade on Thursday as profit-taking capped gains posted during the day, helped by a weak yen and news that Japan's rubber stocks were down on December 20, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.4 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark June was 0.4 yen down at 148.7 yen.
"During the day, the pace of price rises was relatively slow considering two bullish factors -- a fall in rubber stocks and the yen's dip," one trader said.
